title: Python Basics - Variables and Print
objectives: Understand how to create variables and display output in Python
instructions:
1. Create a variable called 'name' and assign your name to it
2. Create a variable called 'age' and assign your age to it
3. Print a message that says: 'Hello, my name is [name] and I am [age] years old.'
4. Try using different data types: string, integer, and float
example:
name = "Alice"
age = 25
print(f"Hello, my name is {name} and I am {age} years old.")
